items.exampleEn: She rudely walked away while I was talking.
items.exampleZh: 我說話時，她很沒禮貌地走開了。

items.exampleEn: He searched feverishly for his lost passport.
items.exampleZh: 他拚命地找他弄丟的護照。

items.exampleEn: Carelessness can cause many mistakes on a test.
items.exampleZh: 粗心會在考試中造成許多錯誤。

items.exampleEn: The pilot's calmness made the passengers feel safe.
items.exampleZh: 機長的冷靜讓乘客感到安心。

items.exampleEn: The movie was long and uninteresting.
My mom looks stressed after a long day at work.
items.exampleZh: 媽媽工作了一整天後看起來壓力很大。

items.exampleEn: My grandpa is a warm-hearted man.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺是個熱心腸的人。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother is unafraid of trying new things.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶勇於嘗試新事物。

items.sentenceEn: Don't speak rudely to your parents.
items.sentenceZh: 不要對父母說話沒禮貌。

items.audioEn: I feel so stressed. My computer broke, and my report is due tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 我壓力好大，電腦壞了，報告明天就要交。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼覺得壓力大？
options: A broken computer and a report deadline.
A friend is moving to another country soon.

items.sentenceEn: He answered the hard questions with great calmness.
items.sentenceZh: 他極為冷靜地回答了那些難題。

items.sentenceEn: The new students were unafraid to ask questions in class.
items.sentenceZh: 新同學們不怕在課堂上發問。

items.stemEn: The book was so ____ that I fell asleep after two pages.
items.stemZh: 這本書無趣到我讀了兩頁就睡著了。

items.stemEn: The students studied ____ the night before the big exam.
items.stemZh: 學生們在大考前一晚拚命地讀書。

items.passageEn: Last week, our class prepared a big dinner for our parents. Everyone worked feverishly in the school kitchen. I was stressed because I had never cooked for so many people. Then, because of one boy's carelessness, a pot of soup boiled over and spilled everywhere. Our teacher handled it with great calmness and cleaned it up quickly. The boy was unafraid to say sorry. Later, another boy spoke rudely to him, but our kind-hearted teacher said that everyone makes mistakes. In the end, the dinner was a success, and our parents spoke positively about the food. Even the vegetable soup, which I thought would be uninteresting, was delicious.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們班為家長準備了一頓豐盛的晚餐。大家在學校廚房裡拚命地工作。我壓力很大，因為我從來沒有為這麼多人做過飯。接著，因為一個男生的粗心，爐子上的一鍋湯滾了出來，灑得到處都是。老師非常冷靜地處理，很快就清理乾淨了。那個男生毫不畏懼地道了歉。後來，另一個男生很沒禮貌地對他說話，但我們好心腸的老師說，每個人都會犯錯。最後，晚餐非常成功，家長們對食物給予了正面的評價。連我本來以為會很無趣的蔬菜湯，也很美味。

questions.questionZh: 湯為什麼灑得到處都是？
options: 有人在廚房裡跑來跑去

questions.questionZh: 老師怎麼回應那個沒禮貌的男生？
options: 叫他立刻離開學校廚房
罰他一個人洗所有的碗

items.promptZh: 他很沒禮貌地嘲笑我的問題。
referenceEn: He rudely laughed at my question.
He laughed at my question rudely.
rubricZh: rudely 表示「無禮地」，例如 rudely laugh at… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 考試快到了，很多學生都很緊張。
referenceEn: The exams are coming, and many students are stressed.
With exams coming soon, a lot of students feel stressed.
rubricZh: 用 stressed 表示「有壓力的；緊張的」（例如 are stressed、feel stressed 等）
